content.short: Chuff provides OpenZeppelin Solidity contract patterns written and optimized in the Huff assembly language.
content.description: Chuff is a compact library of Solidity contract patterns implemented in Huff by Chainlink developer Alex Roan (August 2022). It provides interfaces and starter code for using OpenZeppelin's SafeMath and Ownable frameworks, delivering noticeable gas savings by compiling with Huff. Chuff's patterns are designed to be small and composable, making it easy to integrate into existing projects. The Huff tooling includes a fast compiler, debugging library, VSCode extension, and project templates to simplify getting started.
content.meta: Chuff provides Huff-optimized implementations of popular Solidity contract patterns. Discover Chuff and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
